title: Amazon Shoppers Can Happily Walk '10+ Miles a Day' in These 'Crazy Comfortable' Sandals - NewsBreak
text:
By Savannah Born ,
10 hours ago By Rebecca Schwitz/Us Weekly The brand that used to be a divisive style choice has successfully reinvented itself into something actually chic, and these platform sandals are the proof. Yes, Crocs are trending in 2026, and given how sleek, comfy and affordable the shoes are, we're embracing the trend with open arms!
The Crocs Brooklyn Platform Sandals are now a cult-favorite, with over 16,000 five-star ratings on Amazon alone. A modest 1.7-inch platform, classic double-strap style and minimal color palette are just a few highlights that give them 'weekend in Charleston' vibes, but an oddly sophisticated look is just the beginning.
See it! Get the Crocs Brooklyn Platform Sandals for $55 on Amazon! Please note, prices are accurate at the date of publication but are subject to change.
The secret weapon is the foam footbed, which turns these stylish summer sandals into all-day walking shoes. One happy shopper put it best: "I have literally walked 10+ miles a day in these shoes on vacation with no complaints. No back pain, no foot pain, nothing." Another reviewer shared, "I would rather wear these than regular sneakers because they’re that comfortable and they’re cute."
Jennifer Garner’s and Julianne Moore’s Classic Summer Sandal Is on Major Sale — And Selling Out
Better yet, these sandals are incredibly durable. "I've had my first pair for 4+ years, and they look great with nearly no signs of wear," a repeat buyer wrote, adding, "I feel like I could run a marathon when I wear them."
Four years of regular wear for $55 is math that makes you snag two colors . Black goes with everything, while warm neutral handles every vacation outfit. And because the ankle strap adjusts, these sandals actually stay put when you're power-walking through the airport or along a cobblestone street.
Even Martha Stewart wears Crocs sandals, so don't just take our word for it! These sleek kicks are a rare combination of style and comfort. Grab a pair and thank Us all season long.
